original_description: MixMatter reconstructs a user-supplied image rather than merely decorating it. Version 3.0.1 restores the original v1 visual baseline: bold disassembly and recomposition, aggressive crop and scale shifts, selective photography, visible halftone or duotone, flattened graphic fields, tactile torn-paper collage, source-adaptive color, and strict source-text protection. Unrelated images must not collapse into one recurring blue/coral/botanical decorative template.
summary_ja: 元画像の特徴を残しながら、コラージュや印刷物風の大胆な構図に再構成する。
limitations: スキル概要には元の文字を保護し、原則として新しい文字を追加しないと説明。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
